# Nexus Ring: Physical Switch for You

> Dock the totem. Open your work tools. Restrict distractions across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android & iOS. No subscription.

## Primary Campaign Message
- **Title:** Nexus Ring: Physical Switch for You
- **Headline:** Stop giving your best hours away.
- **Kickstarter Campaign:** https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/naqash/nexus-ring-physical-switch-for-you
- **Philosophy:** Physical Intent Computing — turning the decision to focus into a repeatable physical action across desktop and mobile without mandatory subscriptions.

## Quick Facts
- **Product Type:** USB-C metal-body desk dock, magnetic totem, desktop & mobile companion apps, and browser Intent Gateway extension (not a wearable ring)
- **Kickstarter Reward Tiers (Est. Delivery July 2027):**
  - **$39 — Nexus: Digital Maker Kit:** 3D-printable STL/STEP files, BOM, embedded firmware & flashing guide, assembly guide, and lifetime core desktop & mobile apps (digital only)
  - **$89 — Early Bird: Nexus & App (First 50 Backers):** Complete assembled metal-body Nexus Ring (Day Silver or Night Obsidian Black), magnetic totem, USB-C cable, and lifetime core desktop & mobile apps
  - **$109 — Nexus + Apps (Featured · First 200 Backers):** Complete assembled metal-body Nexus Ring (Day Silver or Night Obsidian Black), magnetic totem, USB-C cable, and lifetime core desktop & mobile apps
  - **$199 — Nexus Ring Duo Pack — Day & Night Edition (50 Backers):** 2× complete assembled Nexus Ring units (both Day Silver and Night Obsidian Black), 2× magnetic totems, 2× USB-C cables, and lifetime core desktop & mobile apps
- **Funding Goal & Duration:** US$ 10,000 · 48 days · Worldwide shipping for assembled tiers (collected separately via post-campaign pledge manager)
- **Hardware Status:** Built and tested; launching first production run on Kickstarter. Wired USB-C metal-body enclosure eliminates internal lithium-ion battery degradation.
- **Supported Platforms:** Windows, macOS, Linux (Desktop), Android & iOS (Mobile Companion via local pairing), and Chromium desktop browsers (Intent Gateway extension for YouTube, Reddit, and X feed filtering).
- **Subscription & AI:** Zero mandatory Nexus subscription for core apps. Core tasks, notes, focus audio, and session records stay local. Optional AI supports Gemini, OpenAI, or a compatible local model endpoint.
- **Creator:** Naqash Afzal Zakria (Lahore, Pakistan)
  - Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/naqash/nexus-ring-physical-switch-for-you

- **Official Website:** https://www.nexusring.tech

## Primary Sections
- **Features & Modes**: 4 dedicated spatial focus positions (Deep Work, Creative, Meeting, Break).
- **Digital Distraction & Attention Economy**: Why modern feeds compete for your time and how to protect focus (https://www.nexusring.tech/digital-distraction).
- **Focus & Discipline Hub**: Evidence-based systems and tailored routines for engineers, designers, and students (https://www.nexusring.tech/focus).
- **The Focus Journal**: In-depth research essays on habit formation, stopping cues, and hardware engineering (https://www.nexusring.tech/journal).
- **Hardware Architecture**: Hall-effect magnetic sensing array, weighted magnetic totem, ESP32-C3 microcontroller (https://www.nexusring.tech/hardware).
- **Software Companion**: Local system automation, native OS integration, configurable profile hooks (https://www.nexusring.tech/software).
- **Development Campaign**: Transparent production roadmap, backer editions, risks and engineering challenges (https://www.nexusring.tech/campaign).
- **Early Access**: Non-binding waitlist registration for prototype milestones and launch news (https://www.nexusring.tech/preorder).
- **Comparisons Hub**: Architectural comparison against software-only blockers and desk accessories (https://www.nexusring.tech/compare).

## Key Principles & Distinctions
1. **Physicality Over Willpower:** Digital tools are easy to ignore because the decision happens on the same screen. Nexus Ring introduces a physical boundary between intention and distraction.
2. **Local System Enforcement:** Switching magnetic totem positions commands the local companion software, triggering native scripts to filter domains, launch workspaces, or silence alerts.
3. **Calm Technology:** Zero screens. Glanceable peripheral light confirms the active state without creating visual clutter.
4. **Privacy-First:** Core automation runs locally without mandatory cloud servers or activity telemetry.

## Common Natural Search Queries Answered by Nexus Ring
- **Focus Assistance & ADHD:** Sensory, tactile focus anchor helping neurodivergent builders and knowledge workers overcome task initiation inertia without notification overload.
- **Distraction Killer:** Physical friction against dopamine loops—displacing the weighted totem breaks mindless feed scrolling and tab switching habits.
- **Discipline Architecture:** Environmental design based on *Atomic Habits*—associating spatial desk cues with deep work to make discipline automatic rather than willpower-dependent.
- **Task & Workspace Automation:** One physical move configures your desktop environment (launches IDE/Figma, mutes Slack alerts, routes distracting domains) locally in under 12ms.

For full technical specifications, code hooks, 200+ natural query taxonomies, and design principles, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.nexusring.tech/llms-full.txt).
